# Tooltip Component Specification

## Purpose
A brief, contextual text overlay that appears when the user hovers or focuses on an element.

## HTML Structure
```html
<button data-kairos-tooltip="Submit your changes" data-kairos-placement="top">Submit</button>

<!-- Dynamically generated by JS near the body end -->
<div class="kairos-tooltip" data-state="open" role="tooltip">
  Submit your changes
</div>
```

## Behavior Contract
- Triggered on `mouseenter` or `focusin`.
- Destroyed or hidden on `mouseleave` or `focusout`.
- A delay (e.g., 300ms) is applied before showing to prevent flashing.
- JS must calculate coordinates dynamically (or use Floating UI / Popper.js logic) based on `data-kairos-placement`.

## Keyboard
- Focus triggers the tooltip.
- `Escape` dismisses the tooltip immediately even if focus remains.

## ARIA
- The trigger must have `aria-describedby` pointing to the dynamically generated tooltip ID.
- Tooltip has `role="tooltip"`.

## Events
- `kairos:tooltip:show`
- `kairos:tooltip:hide`

## Edge Cases
- **Scrolling**: If the user scrolls while the tooltip is open, it should either follow the element or immediately hide.
- **Edge Collision**: If `placement="top"` hits the viewport edge, JS must flip it to `bottom`.
